title: Orphaned future-work direction from W2773444500 (2018)
explanation: Future-work item from openalex:W2773444500 (2018) is unaddressed by any later corpus paper through 2025 (7 yrs). 16 later topically-near papers exist and none addresses it (two-stage matcher). Item: "Determine how algorithmic systems sifting through historical worker data in PLM settings should incorporate group membership considerations.". CORPUS-RELATIVE CAVEAT: 'orphaned' means unaddressed WITHIN this 99-paper corpus, not the field; the two-stage matcher's precision is limited (P≈0.64) and the corpus is a sample, so this is a weak, corpus-relative signal — not evidence the field ignored it.

caveats.label: Corpus-relative
caveats.detail: 'Orphaned' means unaddressed WITHIN this 99-paper corpus, not the field; the two-stage matcher precision is ~0.64.

consumer.kind_short: A question a paper said needed studying, that nothing else in this library followed up on
consumer.kind_long: When researchers finish a paper they usually name the questions they could not get to. We collected those, then checked whether any later paper in this library actually went and did the work. These are the ones where nothing did.
consumer.strength_meaning: There is real evidence behind this, but it rests on a small number of papers — read them before trusting it.
consumer.why: A paper said this needed studying. That was 7 years ago. Since then 16 later papers in this library worked on closely related topics, and none of them took this up.

caveats.text: Nothing in this library followed this up — but this library is 99 papers, not the whole field. Somebody outside it may well have answered this already. Check before you invest.
